title: Understanding groupby and head
text: The `groupby` function in pandas is used to split the data into groups based on some criteria. The `head(1)` function returns the first row of each group. Consider how many unique values are in column 'a'.

title: Identifying Unique Groups
text: Look at column 'a' in the DataFrame. How many unique values do you see? These unique values determine the number of groups formed by `groupby`.
